sprints.goal: Character moves in a test room
One real level loads and plays
Vertical slice ready for First Playable

stories.title: Core character movement (run, jump, coyote time)
acceptance_criteria: Player can run and jump with tuned acceleration
Coyote time and jump buffer feel responsive in playtest

stories.title: Main menu and options screen
acceptance_criteria: New Game / Options / Quit work
Resolution and volume settings persist

stories.title: Tilemap level loader
acceptance_criteria: Levels load from Tiled export
Collision layer imports correctly

stories.title: Camera follow with look-ahead and room bounds
acceptance_criteria: Camera follows player with smoothed look-ahead
Camera never shows outside the room bounds
No visible jitter at 60fps on the target laptop
evidence: playtest 10-10: no jitter reported by 3 players
clip in #playtest channel showing bounds clamp

stories.title: Enemy pathfinding around static obstacles
acceptance_criteria: Grunt enemy navigates around walls to reach the player
No pathing hitches when 6 enemies are active
Enemies do not clip through thin platforms

stories.title: Save and load (single slot)
acceptance_criteria: Game state round-trips through save then load
Corrupt or missing save file falls back to a new game without crashing

stories.title: Combat hit reactions and knockback
acceptance_criteria: Hit enemies flash and get knocked back proportional to hit
Player takes knockback and i-frames on hit
Hitstop tuned and toggleable in a debug menu

stories.title: In-game HUD (health, ammo, objective marker)
acceptance_criteria: Health and ammo update live
Objective marker points to the current goal
HUD scales cleanly at 1080p and 1440p

stories.title: Audio mixer, SFX buses, and first pass sound set
acceptance_criteria: Master / Music / SFX buses controllable from options
Movement, jump, hit, and pickup sounds present
No clipping at max volume

stories.title: Level 2 blockout (greybox, playable start to finish)
acceptance_criteria: Level 2 is walkable from entrance to exit
At least 3 encounter spaces roughed in
Reviewed by Design Lead

stories.title: Tutorial / first-time-user flow
acceptance_criteria: New player is taught move, jump, attack, interact in-world (no text walls)
A playtester who has never seen the game can clear the tutorial unaided

stories.title: Boss 1 encounter design (paper + whitebox plan)
acceptance_criteria: Three attack patterns documented with timings
Arena layout sketched
Tech Lead confirms it is buildable in the engine

stories.title: Upgrade / progression system design
acceptance_criteria: Upgrade list with costs and effects
Economy math sanity-checked against level length

stories.title: Level 3 concept
acceptance_criteria: Theme, hook, and new mechanic identified
One-page brief approved by team

stories.title: New Game+ mode
acceptance_criteria: Rules for a second playthrough defined
Scoped as cut-able if time is short

stories.title: Accessibility options (remap, hold-vs-toggle, text size)
acceptance_criteria: Full control remapping
Hold actions have a toggle alternative
UI text scale option
